title: The Hermit Road: First Remnant
obscured_text: The stone is stained through, but the marks recoil from your attention.
It remembers an invitation, but not enough of you.
revealed_text: This remnant was once a hermit's cell. The display is gone, the witness is gone, and only the blood-stained stone remains to hold the shape of the invitation.
The echo is not yours, but it rhymes with your own beginning. Someone else was called here. Someone did not return to answer.
